title: 3dBlurToFWHM
description: Blurs a 'master' dataset until it reaches a specified FWHM smoothness (approximately).

automask.description: Create an automask from the input dataset.
automask.title: Automask

blurmaster.description: The dataset whose smoothness controls the process.
blurmaster.title: Blurmaster

fwhm.description: Blur until the 3d fwhm reaches this value (in mm).
fwhm.title: Fwhm

fwhmxy.description: Blur until the 2d (x,y)-plane fwhm reaches this value (in mm).
fwhmxy.title: Fwhmxy

in_file.description: The dataset that will be smoothed.
in_file.title: In file

mask.description: Mask dataset, if desired. voxels not in mask will be set to zero in output.
mask.title: Mask
